description: Android apps for Monitor, a wall-mounted tablet product: live video from IP cameras over RTSP/ONVIF, camera integrations and native libraries. Now also React Native with Expo.

Led the Android architecture, and set up CI/CD and a code review process for the team.
Set the product roadmap, delivered the MVP, and led a Node.js backend and a Flutter marketplace app.
Android and iOS apps, including Daif (Hajj crowd management), Graphmented (AR data visualization on iOS) and Qmotor.
